title: Zooming In on Choice: How Do Consumers Search for Cameras Online?
authors: Bart J. Bronnenberg; Jun Beom Kim; Carl F. Mela
eligible_reason: Not a DiD. Descriptive search-behavior paper: tables.do and figures.do regress attribute distances of searched cameras relative to the chosen camera on search-sequence decile indicators with consumer (machine) FE (areg ... abs(machine)), choice on search-position indicators (xtreg fe), and a structural search model estimated in Matlab (Table 4, App. Table 7). No treatment adoption or calendar-time design.
design_notes: Stata (areg, xtreg) and Matlab (runmodel.m). comScore-type clickstream search data for digital cameras: searchdata.dta (29,069 search events, 26 vars) and kwdata.dta (2,923 keyword searches).

ineligible_specs_listed.location: heterogeneity, informativeness, state-dependence, revisiting and funnel tables; figures
ineligible_specs_listed.reason: search-sequence position indicators within consumer; descriptive, no treatment

data_files_note: Both analysis files shipped; abstract states data are available as supplemental material.
data_provenance_note: No statement of masking or simulation.
screener_notes: Screened from package and OpenAlex abstract (no article text, no PDF). code_prescore 2 from areg with consumer FE; no DiD.
